summary.name: Fliki
summary.one_liner: Fliki is a text-to-video AI tool that turns scripts, blog posts, or prompts into videos with AI voiceovers, visuals, music, and captions.
use_cases: Turning a blog post or script into a narrated video
Making faceless TikToks, Reels, or YouTube Shorts
Converting PowerPoint or Google Slides into narrated training videos
Adding AI voiceover or dubbing to existing video
Creating a digital twin presenter from your own recording
summary.what_it_does: Fliki takes pasted text, a script, a blog post, or a one-line prompt and generates a video with an AI-written script, visuals, AI voiceover, music, and subtitles. The page lists 2,000+ AI voices in 80+ languages and dialects, plus voice cloning from a short sample and dubbing into other languages. It offers a digital twin feature that creates an AI version of a user's face and voice from a recording for use in later videos. The page also says it can plan and draft content on a schedule and integrates several named third-party AI video, voice, and image models. It converts PPT or Google Slides files into narrated video scenes.
notable: 2,000+ AI voices in 80+ languages with voice cloning and dubbing
Digital twin: AI version of your face and voice for presenting videos
Converts blog posts, scripts, and PowerPoint/Google Slides into narrated videos
Integrates third-party models from OpenAI, Google, Kling, Bytedance, and ElevenLabs
caveats: Free plan exists, but the page says commercial rights come with paid plans
Voice cloning is described as working in 70+ languages on one FAQ answer, versus 80+ elsewhere
Page claims (14M users, 4.8/5 rating, 50,000+ companies) are self-reported marketing figures
